walkthrough: Identify the given vectors: $F_1 = 10 \text{ N}$, $F_2 = 10 \text{ N}$, with angle $\theta = 120^{\circ}$ between them tail-to-tail at P.
State the vector-addition rule for magnitude: $R^2 = F_1^2 + F_2^2 + 2F_1F_2\cos\theta$.
Substitute values with units: $R^2 = (10 \text{ N})^2 + (10 \text{ N})^2 + 2(10 \text{ N})(10 \text{ N})\cos 120^{\circ}$.
A $10 \text{ N}$ resultant matches the symmetric parallelogram formed by two equal vectors at $120^{\circ}$. This is option B.
